v2_reranked.description: BGE reranker order over the same embedding top-30 candidate pool

judgment_scope: partial_explicit_judgments; unjudged places are not asserted irrelevant

accuracy_definitions.top_1_accuracy: Fraction of evaluated queries whose first result has human relevance >= 2.
accuracy_definitions.top_5_accuracy: Fraction of evaluated queries with at least one human relevance >= 2 result in the first 5 positions (Hit@5).
accuracy_definitions.recall_at_5: Mean per-query fraction of the known relevant place IDs retrieved in the first K positions; distinct from Top-K accuracy.

metric_interpretation: Human relevance >= 2 defines a known relevant place. Top-1 accuracy and Top-5 accuracy are query-level hit rates, not precision or recall. Ranking metrics use cutoff 5; NDCG uses graded relevance. Unjudged candidates are not confirmed errors: no-known-hit scores are conservative when candidates remain unjudged. Recall covers the known relevant set, not exhaustive corpus recall.
